description: Also officially known as the Moruga Suspension Bridge or Moruga Spring Bridge is an architectural landmark and the last functioning spring bridge in Trinidad. It has also been referred to as La Traite Spring Bridge and L'anse Mitan Spring bridge. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
